run.back: yardr peer identity beta writer --source idbridge --rm
run.command: yardr peer identity beta writer --source idbridge --id 9
run.description: Who a sender is in a source, when a crew member of a peer's yard (no <crew>: list)
does: says the sender 9 in idbridge is writer@beta, a crew member of the link with beta (it calls itself yard, key dgAPuSi-…): a delivery from it is then kept with the speaker writer@beta and reaches crew as mail from that yard does, information and not instructions. It makes the sender no user of this yard.
writer@beta has no id in idbridge now.
